name: netloggedon
help: Lists logged-on users; Linux and macOS support the local host only.
long_help: On Windows, uses NetWkstaUserEnum to enumerate users on the local or selected remote workstation, including domain and logon-server details. On Linux and macOS, lists local login records from /usr/bin/who and rejects a non-empty remote computer argument; Windows domain and logon-server fields are not available.

arguments.name: computername
arguments.desc: Target computer to query (defaults to local system if not specified)
